description:
Enjoy the best of Los Angeles with this two hour guided eBike tour that begins in Santa Monica near the famous Santa Monica Pier! You must be at least 16 to ride our pedal assist ebikes. There will be guests riding standard, non-electric bikes on this tour. Take in the ocean breezes, visit the historic Venice Canals, ride through Marina del Rey, take pictures with the Art Walls, and explore Muscle Beach. You’ll be able to visit all of the main highlights that the area has to offer, while learning fun facts, seeing beautiful views, and more! 

This guided tour takes about 3 hours, including various stops near essential attractions while our guides provide in-depth narration and stop for photo opportunities at famous sights and hidden gems throughout the tour. For safety reasons, we are unable to attach tag-a-longs and trailers to ebikes.

Guests must be 16+ to ride an eBike!
